Class CustomSpecies

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.species.CustomSpecies
All Implemented Interfaces:
Species
Direct Known Subclasses:
ApisMellifera, AttaCephalotes, AustroplatypusIncompertus, Camponotus, CamponotusPennsylvanicus, FormicaRufa, KladothripsHarteri, LasiusNiger, LinepithemaHumile, PseudoregmaBambucicola, ReticulitermesFlavipes, SmartAntSpecies, SoldierAntSpecies, SolenopsisInvicta, VespulaGermanica
public class CustomSpecies extends Object implements Species
A comprehensive, customizable species definition supporting realistic eusocial insects (ants, bees, wasps, termites, etc.).
Author:
Silvère Martin-Michiellot, Gemini AI Assistant
